_what_this_is: The stack-specific half of DynaChat's harness. `ci.py` is the ladder and is
identical to the one the build-dark-factory skill ships; everything that makes it
about THIS repo is in here.
Both rungs point at a small runner in harness/ rather than at a single tool,
because DynaChat is two stacks and `ci.py` runs one command per rung. The ladder
stays the same in every factory; the split lives in static.py and unit.py.
Every command here is lifted from .archon/workflows/dark-factory-validate-pr.yaml
so there is ONE definition of a green build. Change one, change the other.
_unit_count_pattern: unit.py sums both halves and refuses to report a number when either half fails or
reports zero. ci.py then re-emits it as the UNIT_PASSED marker the gate asserts.
_driver: http: the FastAPI backend. /api/health, NOT /health - pointing at the wrong path
is a real incident in this repo's history (c4997c4, 2026-04-15), and it fails in
the worst way: every run dies identically, which masks whatever you were debugging.
The backend hard-requires DATABASE_URL and friends at IMPORT time. That is why the
start command sources a validation env file that lives OUTSIDE the repo. Without
it uvicorn crashes before the health check ever answers - which is exactly the
3fc03a0 incident, where a crashed backend was scored as 'not e2e testable' and a
PR auto-merged having never been driven through a browser.

_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE, and this is the honest gap. The real DynaChat journey is the
